title: Examples
text: Read from one or more input channels not handled by specific blocks, 2 outputs, {Output data type} sets Data type of block output; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Input channels} selects other input channels and {Optional parameters} sets the optional parameters that the driver. Values come from the instance.
